description: FinTech Forge 2026 – Innovate Finance. Build Tomorrow. Organised by Proton Solutions FinTech Forge 2026 is an innovation-driven hackathon designed to bring together students, developers, programmers, entrepreneurs and technology enthusiasts to explore the future of financial technology. The hackathon challenges participants to develop innovative, secure, scalable and user-friendly technology solutions that address real-world financial challenges. Participants will have the opportunity to explore emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Blockchain, Digital Payments, Financial Automation, Open Banking and Data Analytics to create impactful financial applications. From intelligent personal finance management and fraud detection to digital payment systems and financial inclusion, participants are encouraged to transform their ideas into practical technology solutions. Hackathon Focus Areas Digital Payments and Payment Innovation AI-Powered Financial Applications Fraud Detection and Financial Security Blockchain and Decentralized Finance Personal Finance and Wealth Management Financial Inclusion and Digital Banking Smart Investment and Risk Analysis Financial Automation and Data Analytics Who Can Participate? Students, developers, programmers, entrepreneurs, innovators and technology enthusiasts from all academic backgrounds are welcome. Why Participate? Build practical FinTech solutions. Explore emerging financial technologies. Gain hands-on software development experience. Demonstrate creativity and problem-solving skills. Collaborate with fellow innovators. Showcase your project to an evaluation panel. Event Format FinTech Forge 2026 will be conducted entirely online through a multi-round competition. Participants will progress through idea submission, prototype development, final project submission and project presentation. Organised By Proton Solutions Join FinTech Forge 2026 and help shape the next generation of financial innovation.

raw.details:
FinTech Forge 2026 – Innovate Finance. Build Tomorrow.

Organised by Proton Solutions

FinTech Forge 2026 is an innovation-driven hackathon designed to bring together students, developers, programmers, entrepreneurs and technology enthusiasts to explore the future of financial technology.

The hackathon challenges participants to develop innovative, secure, scalable and user-friendly technology solutions that address real-world financial challenges.

Participants will have the opportunity to explore emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Blockchain, Digital Payments, Financial Automation, Open Banking and Data Analytics to create impactful financial applications.

From intelligent personal finance management and fraud detection to digital payment systems and financial inclusion, participants are encouraged to transform their ideas into practical technology solutions.

Hackathon Focus Areas

  • Digital Payments and Payment Innovation

  • AI-Powered Financial Applications

  • Fraud Detection and Financial Security

  • Blockchain and Decentralized Finance

  • Personal Finance and Wealth Management

  • Financial Inclusion and Digital Banking

  • Smart Investment and Risk Analysis

  • Financial Automation and Data Analytics

Who Can Participate?

Students, developers, programmers, entrepreneurs, innovators and technology enthusiasts from all academic backgrounds are welcome.

Why Participate?

  • Build practical FinTech solutions.

  • Explore emerging financial technologies.

  • Gain hands-on software development experience.

  • Demonstrate creativity and problem-solving skills.

  • Collaborate with fellow innovators.

  • Showcase your project to an evaluation panel.

Event Format

FinTech Forge 2026 will be conducted entirely online through a multi-round competition. Participants will progress through idea submission, prototype development, final project submission and project presentation.

Organised By

Proton Solutions

Join FinTech Forge 2026 and help shape the next generation of financial innovation.

Think Beyond Banking. Innovate Beyond Limits.
